intro: We list {{count}} MBA / PGDM colleges in Telangana where our records show a highest package of at least ₹{{threshold}} lakh. They include NIT Warangal, ISB Hyderabad and IBS Hyderabad.

These MBA colleges in Telangana with ₹50 lakh highest package are a mixed set. ISB Hyderabad now qualifies on its flagship PGP record, not the senior-executive PGPMAX row. Some private-college records still have a very wide gap between average and highest.
listLead: The ISB Hyderabad card that now meets this threshold is the flagship PGP for 2023, with an average of ₹34 LPA and a highest of ₹72 LPA in our records. That is not the senior-executive PGPMAX programme.
snapshot: Across these {{colleges}} colleges, the median recorded average package is {{pkgMedian}}, from placement years {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
Recorded averages run from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The highest single figure we hold is {{highestMax}}, at NIT Warangal's MBA for 2023.
ICFAI Foundation for Higher Education, Hyderabad, is 46th in the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking. NIT Warangal does not appear in that top 100.
firstCollegesLead: CMR College of Engineering and Technology's 2023 MBA row shows an average of ₹4 LPA and a highest of ₹58 LPA. BV Raju Institute has a 2023 highest of ₹54 LPA and no average in our file.
Those two records need the official placement report before you treat them as typical outcomes. IBS Hyderabad's 2022 MBA row shows an average of ₹9 LPA and a highest of ₹53 LPA.

sections.heading: Flagship programmes versus executive programmes
paragraphs: The card now uses the flagship PGP record (average ₹34 LPA, highest ₹72 LPA in our file). Still confirm the official PGP placement report for the Hyderabad campus, and use PGPMAX numbers only if that is the programme you will join.

compare.heading: How to compare MBA colleges in Telangana with ₹50 lakh highest package
paragraphs: An NIT MBA, an ISB flagship PGP and a private engineering-college MBA share little except this threshold in our file.
bullets: The exact programme — MBA, flagship PGP or another specialised course.
The average beside the highest, especially where the average is missing or very low.
The entrance test (CAT, TS ICET, IBSAT or NMAT) and the current fee notice.
The latest official placement report for the same campus and programme.

faqs.question: Which MBA colleges in Telangana with ₹50 lakh highest package are listed here?
faqs.answer: {{count}} colleges: NIT Warangal, ISB Hyderabad, CMR College of Engineering and Technology, BV Raju Institute of Technology, and IBS Hyderabad.

faqs.question: What average packages do these colleges report?
faqs.answer: The median recorded average is {{pkgMedian}}, with recorded averages from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. BV Raju Institute has a highest-package figure but no average in our file.

faqs.question: Is the ISB figure now for the flagship PGP?
faqs.answer: The card now shows the flagship PGP for 2023, with an average of ₹34 LPA and a highest of ₹72 LPA in our records. Confirm the official PGP report if that is the programme you want.

faqs.question: Is NIT Warangal in the NIRF 2025 Management top 100?
faqs.answer: No. It does not appear in the official NIRF 2025 Management top 100. Our 2023 MBA record shows an average of ₹17 LPA and a highest of ₹88 LPA, which should be checked in the official report.

faqs.question: Are these packages guaranteed?
faqs.answer: No. They are historical records from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}. Offers change with every batch, so confirm the latest official placement report.
